ABOUT US

A Passion For Great Nigerian Food.

At Rahman Kitchen, we believe great food brings people together. Every meal is cooked from scratch with fresh ingredients, traditional recipes and a lot of care.

From party jollof and smoky suya to rich egusi and pounded yam, we bring you the flavours you grew up loving, in a warm and welcoming setting.
